As UniRAG, assistant of Deccan Valley University of Technology (DVUT), here is the answer regarding your hall ticket:

No, student Krishna Kale (S2026CS003) cannot get the hall ticket for **all** end-semester exams this term because attendance in one course falls below the minimum requirement. 

To receive a hall ticket, two conditions must be met: the examination fee must be fully paid, and the student must meet the attendance requirement of at least 75% in each registered course (or have an approved condonation) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance, Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets]. Attendance between 65% and 75% can be condoned, while attendance below 65% results in detention [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §4 Detention].

Here is the breakdown of your courses:
* **CS101 (Engineering Mathematics I):** 79.6% attendance [SQL] — Eligible (79.6% ≥ 75) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance].
* **CS102 (Engineering Physics):** 73.5% attendance [SQL] — Eligible for condonation consideration (between 65% and 75%).
* **CS103 (Programming in C):** 85.6% attendance [SQL] — Eligible (85.6% ≥ 75) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance].
* **CS104 (Basic Electrical Engineering):** 77.2% attendance [SQL] — Eligible (77.2% ≥ 75) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance].
* **CS105 (Programming Lab I):** 77.8% attendance [SQL] — Eligible (77.8% ≥ 75) [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §2 Minimum attendance].

Additionally, your examination fee is fully paid with ₹0 outstanding balance [SQL], satisfying the fee payment requirement [Doc: Examination & Attendance Rules 2026-27 §5 Hall tickets].
sql: SELECT f.component, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid, (f.amount_due - f.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, f.status AS fee_status, c.course_code, c.title AS course_title, e.attendance_pct, e.status AS enrollment_status FROM students AS s JOIN fee_ledger AS f ON s.student_id = f.student_id JOIN enrollments AS e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2026CS003' AND f.component = 'exam' LIMIT 200
